growth.source: MFDS quasi-drug production statistics 2023 and 2024, via Medifonews (derived)
growth.notes: CONTRARY SIGNAL, flagged deliberately. Korean domestic toothpaste PRODUCTION fell 3.27% in CY2024 while every aggregator on file forecasts Korean oral care growing 6.4-6.9% a year. These are not the same measure (rule 11): production is domestic factory-gate output of dentifrice only, whereas the aggregator figures are retail sell-through across the whole oral-care basket including mouthwash, brushes and imports. A domestic production decline alongside retail growth is consistent with import substitution and/or category mix shifting toward non-dentifrice formats, but that is a hypothesis, not a reconciled result — do NOT publish this as 'the' Korea oral care growth rate. Total quasi-drug production also fell over the same period (KRW 1조 6,822억 to 1조 6,037억).

shares.qualifier: Shares of summed revenue for 2 listed BRAND OWNERS (KRW krw_tn, NET_REALISATION). Does NOT include unorganised/unlisted players. Conglomerate members (HUL/Godrej/LG H&H) carry non-BPC revenue, so their shares overstate BPC position. Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand shares): CJ Olive Young (retailer), Cosmax (odm), Kolmar Korea (odm). Excluded (different currency/unit): Innisfree.

bottom_up.qualifier: Sum of latest reported revenue for 2 listed players (KRW krw_tn), NET_REALISATION basis. Coverage excludes unorganised/unlisted competitors. NOT a market size: LG H&H report revenue well beyond BPC (conglomerate/total-company figures). Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand owners): CJ Olive Young (retailer), Cosmax (odm), Kolmar Korea (odm). Excluded (different currency/unit): Innisfree.

mismatches: Unit/currency differ (top-down USD usd_bn vs bottom-up KRW krw_tn) - convert before comparing.
Value basis differs (top-down RETAIL vs bottom-up NET_REALISATION). India RETAIL vs NET_REALISATION differ by the MRP trade margin (lib/transforms/mrp_normalise.py).
Bottom-up base is inflated by non-pure-play conglomerates (LG H&H) reporting non-BPC revenue.
reconciliation.note: Numeric gap not computed: bases are not directly comparable (see mismatches). Bottom-up here is a coverage indicator, not a market-size cross-check.
